generation.prompt: Create one production logo asset sheet on a genuinely transparent background, not a mockup. Both rows use exactly the same spelling, proportions, layout, and motif. Each row: a separate bold compact emblem on the far left, then a generous transparent horizontal gap, then the complete business name at right. The left emblem must remain unmistakable at 32 px. The complete name must be clean and legible at a small website-header size; use strong simple shapes and avoid tiny taglines. TOP ROW is the dark-ink version for WHITE backgrounds. BOTTOM ROW is the light-ink version for CHARCOAL or RED backgrounds: replace every dark text fill with solid white, preserving accent colours only where they remain readable. Use a thin contrasting keyline around coloured details so they remain visible on all backgrounds. Flat graphic design, crisp edges, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no shadow, no photography, no microtype. Real transparent alpha everywhere outside the actual shapes. Wide landscape canvas with equal row spacing and generous outer transparent margins. This is an independent dealer preview; no approval claims. Faithfully redraw the dealer identity UNLIMITED MOTORS from the provided public logo. Preserve its charcoal and mint-teal palette, bold geometric automotive lettering, and sports-car silhouette motif. Make a fresh clean simplified silhouette, not a traced raster; remove all stock-watermark wording from the new artwork, no Design.com text. Compact emblem at left is a sturdy mint U integrated with a minimal sports-car roof. Complete name UNLIMITED MOTORS at right in two strong lines. Top uses charcoal words; bottom uses solid white words with mint accents.
